prompt:
This image is a painted grand-strategy map seen straight down, with Không Mông Thành painted at its centre. Change ONLY the place at the centre, and only as described; keep its layout, every existing building, the terrain, the water, the colours and the golden-hour light from the top left exactly as they are, so the two images can be swapped on the map.

The place grows one development level: A second wall ring up the valley sides; covered bridges link the arcades across the river, and the harbour gains a stone breakwater.

Keep the change inside a circle about 22 % of the image width across the centre. Never: text, labels, writing, symbols on flags, people larger than specks, a frame, a vignette.
